text_simplified: Patience is one of the most important factors in successful upbringing; parents must be patient in guiding, nursing, and educating their child, counting that as striving in the cause of Allah while being certain that guidance is in the Hand of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. Parents must also beware of a driver being alone with a daughter in the car, and beware of leaving the upbringing of daughters to maids who do not pray or who disobey Allah and thus affect their creed and morals.
